      - name: Upload PHP observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: consumer-results-php-native-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/consumer-ci/results/php-native.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Enforce PHP support
        if: steps.consumer.outcome != 'success' || steps.ordinary_php.outcome != 'success' || steps.type_corpus_php_native.outcome != 'success' || steps.owned_php.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

  php-wasm-consumers:
    name: PHP-Wasm
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # The shared PHP-Wasm corpus is the growing tail; 330 minutes leaves room below the hosted six-hour limit.
    timeout-minutes: 330
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
      - name: Restore pinned PHP and compiler inputs
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            .toolchains
            build/php-wasm-sdk
            build/php-wasm-host
          key: consumer-php-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('flake.lock', 'lean-toolchain', 'scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh', 'scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh', 'poc/lean-link-spike/bindings/php-wasm.package.json') }}
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Bound apt network waits
        uses: ./.github/actions/bounded-apt
        timeout-minutes: 1
      - name: Install apt dependencies for Install native PHP and PHP-Wasm host build tools
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential autoconf automake bison flex gperf libtool re2c cmake pkg-config php-cli php-dev php-common php-zip php-mbstring composer zstd ripgrep
      - name: Install native PHP and PHP-Wasm host build tools
        run: |
          bash scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh --check-prerequisites
      - name: Disable host PHP debugging instrumentation
        run: |
          if /usr/bin/php -r 'exit(extension_loaded("xdebug") ? 0 : 1);'; then
            sudo phpdismod -s cli xdebug
          fi
          env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /usr/bin/php -r 'if (extension_loaded("xdebug")) { fwrite(STDERR, "Consumer PHP must run without Xdebug.\n"); exit(1); }'
      - name: Build twice, install, and execute the PHP-Wasm transport
        id: consumer
        continue-on-error: true
        run: npm run test:consumer:php-wasm
